audience: Estimators and preconstruction teams at general contractors
headline: Still leveling sub bids by hand?
symptoms: Every proposal arrives in a different format
Scope nobody priced turns up after award
Questions to bidders get lost in email threads
build: Bid leveling that reads every proposal into one sheet, traces each number to its page, flags scope no bidder carried and drafts the questions to send.

screens.caption: Every sub proposal read into one package
Leveling sheet, every cell traced to its page
